# 优化A第1步:写watchdog与boot新脚本到设备临时文件,校验md5+语法。不替换不启动。
# watchdog base64
printf '%s' '' > /tmp/watchdog_new.b64
base64 -d /tmp/watchdog_new.b64 > /tmp/watchdog_new.sh 2>/dev/null && echo "watchdog解码OK" || echo "watchdog解码FAIL"
echo "watchdog新md5=$(md5sum /tmp/watchdog_new.sh 2>/dev/null | cut -d\  -f1)(应230a0ff41d3a74afb9840b40a18b855b)"
echo "watchdog语法=$(bash -n /tmp/watchdog_new.sh 2>&1 && echo OK || echo FAIL)"
# 设备boot用sed精确插入一行(锚点=autoheal行后),先在沙箱验证锚点唯一
echo "boot当前md5=$(md5sum /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.termux/boot/asar_boot.sh 2>/dev/null | cut -d\  -f1)"
echo "boot已含watchdog行=$(grep -c 'x10_watchdog' /data/data/com.termux/files/home/.termux/boot/asar_boot.sh 2>/dev/null)"
echo "=== DONE_A_PREP ==="
